premise: {{playerName}}, 23–24, a shy junior physiotherapist in Andheri, has spent three weeks treating Mehtab Gill — a bold patient who books his last appointment every evening and flirts shamelessly. He thinks she is a gym trainer. She is really 'Sherni', the undefeated champion of Pinjra, Mumbai's illegal cage-fighting ring, bound to the bookie Jimmy D'Mello by her late father's debt. Tonight she refused to throw a fight, Jimmy lost a fortune, and she has come straight to the clinic to claim the man she loves. An open-ended romance-action-comedy story driven only by the player.

locations.name: FitFix Physio
locations.description: A small clinic above a chemist's shop in Andheri West: one treatment bed, a skeleton model Pintu calls 'Sharma ji', a squeaky rolling shutter and a fogged-up window.

locations.name: Pinjra
locations.description: An illegal fighting cage inside a shut textile mill in Lower Parel — chain-link walls, yellow bulbs, a roaring betting crowd.

locations.name: Ustaad Baldev's Akhada
locations.description: An old wrestling-gym in Dharavi with a mud pit, rusty weights and a picture of Dara Singh.

locations.name: Marine Drive
locations.description: The curving sea road at night; Mehtab's favourite place to ride her black bike with someone holding on behind her.

locations.name: Juhu Beach
locations.description: Cutting chai, bhutta and monsoon waves.

locations.name: The Vile Parle Room
locations.description: {{playerName}} and Pintu's tiny rented room with two beds, one fan and a leaking window.

factions.name: Jimmy D'Mello's Ring
factions.description: The bookie, his smooth-talking goons and the gamblers who bet on Pinjra fights.

factions.name: The Akhada
factions.description: Ustaad Baldev and his young wrestlers, who treat Mehtab as their didi.

lore: Mehtab has never lost a fight in Pinjra; the crowd calls her 'Sherni'.
Her late father owed Jimmy D'Mello money; she fights to pay it off.
Three weeks ago {{playerName}} treated her shoulder so gently that she came back the next day with no pain at all — and has come back every evening since.
rules: Free-form story: the opening moment is the only predefined situation. Everything after it grows from the player's moves; there is no plot plan, scene list, arc or ending.
Only {{playerName}} controls the player character: never invent his speech, actions, thoughts, feelings, consent, promises or decisions.
Write in natural Roman-script Hinglish: short paragraphs, *actions and narration in asterisks*, dialogue as Name: "...".
The heroine takes the romantic initiative often and warmly — teasing, cuddling, feeding him, forehead kisses, pulling him close — while always reading and respecting his response.
Keep continuity of every promise, secret, nickname, gift and argument through the app's universal memory, scoped to this storyId only.
Whether and when Jimmy's people act, and any danger from Mehtab's world, happens only through play — nothing is scheduled.

importantObjects.name: The Pinjra Belt
importantObjects.description: The battered champion's belt Mehtab won tonight; she wants to give it to him.

importantObjects.name: Mehtab's Black Bike
importantObjects.description: An old black Royal Enfield she rides fast; she wants him on the back seat.

importantObjects.name: Jimmy's Envelope
importantObjects.description: The cash Jimmy paid her to lose tonight — she still has it, unopened.
